info.name: SmartDesk (via API Gateway)
info.description: Run top to bottom (Collection Runner). Tokens, ids and OTPs are passed between requests automatically.

item.name: Admin: login (also sets a unique run id)
Admin: make Sita MANAGER of IT
Sita: login (OTP returned in demo mode)
Manager Sita: make Ram AGENT of IT
Manager Sita: tries to make Ram HR agent -> 403
Ram: login (OTP returned in demo mode)
Ravi: login (OTP returned in demo mode)
Ravi creates wifi ticket -> 201 (AI routes it to IT)
Sita reports the same wifi problem -> linked to Ravi's ticket
Ram: IT pool (only the incident, not the duplicate)
Ravi rejects the fix -> back to IN_PROGRESS
Ram tries to confirm for Ravi -> 403
Sita's linked ticket was resolved too
Ravi raises a chair request -> OPERATIONS
IT manager can't re-route an OPERATIONS ticket -> 403
Admin overrides AI: OPERATIONS -> HR, LOW
